{{Quote|This is Stormtrooper L-S-zero-zero-five. Reporting for Agent Kallus.|"LS-005"|<ref name="The Rebellion Begins">''[[The Rebellion Begins]]''</ref>}}
"'''LS-005'''" was a the [[callsign]] of a [[stormtrooper]] who served the [[Imperial Army]].<ref name="SOR" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'', which includes LS-005's appearance, to [[5 BBY]].</ref> whilst stationed on the [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Lawbringer]]'', he was assigned by [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] to guard a [[Prison|cell]] containing [[Ezra Bridger]]. When Bridger escaped from his holding cell with him and another trooper inside, LS-005 reported to Kallus through a [[comlink]]. Another [[officer]] then reported of the ''[[Ghost]]'' entering the destroyer undetected. Bridger, who had stolen an Imperial helmet, proceeded to mimic a stormtrooper, under the ID "LS-123," trying to trick Kallus into going to the upper [[hangar]], whereas the ''Ghost'' was trying to dock in the lower hangar.<ref name="SOR" />
